releaseTitle: Hotspot Manager v1.5.6 - Pro Topology & Data Seller Hub
releaseNotes:
• Network Topology Pro: Ultra-smooth zero-jank graph with live 5 GHz backhaul throughput meters
• Enhanced AirMetro Pair Auto-Detect: Sequential MAC delta (<= 4) matching, confidence scores, and 1-tap Base/CPE swap
• Exact Starlink GB Accounting: Continuous 2-decimal GB usage tracking with live active client counter
• Per-Profile Activated Vouchers Modal: Tap any profile to inspect all active vouchers, IPs, MACs, and exact quota consumed
• Mobile Data Seller Quick Dispense: 1-tap voucher selling with automatic Bluetooth thermal printer integration
• Low Inventory Warnings: Real-time alert banner when voucher stock runs low for any profile
• Customer Quota Lookup: Instant status, time left, and remaining data search by voucher code
• New AP & Router Hardware Assets: High-resolution photorealistic imagery for Ruijie RAP2266, MikroTik hAP ax3, cAP ax, and RB5009
• Captive Portal Direct IP Redirect: Clean login redirect without DNS dependency
